objective: Determine whether absolute adaptive round-number crossings contain conditional continuation after destination-side acceptance or reversal after prompt rejection, with enough cost-adjusted persistence and trade independence to justify exact BBO/depth reconstruction.

used_pre_cutoff_sources.title: Price clustering in Bitcoin
used_pre_cutoff_sources.role: round-number clustering is real, but unconditional post-round returns are not significant; directional rules therefore require causal acceptance or rejection conditioning

used_pre_cutoff_sources.title: Intraday price behavior of cryptocurrencies
used_pre_cutoff_sources.authors: Bill Hu, Thomas McInish, Jonathan Miller, Li Zeng
used_pre_cutoff_sources.role: intraday trades cluster at round numbers and immediately adjacent prices, supporting an absolute-grid and strategic-pricing state

used_pre_cutoff_sources.title: Intraday patterns of price clustering in Bitcoin
used_pre_cutoff_sources.role: tick-level BTC prices cluster most at 00 and also at 99/01; clustering varies intraday and with transaction activity

used_pre_cutoff_sources.title: Evidence for round number effects in cryptocurrencies prices
used_pre_cutoff_sources.authors: Raquel Quiroga-Garcia, Natalia Pariente-Martinez, Mar Arenas-Parra
used_pre_cutoff_sources.role: high-frequency ETH/Ripple/Litecoin prices and traded volume cluster at round levels, supporting a cross-asset but dimensionless grid formulation

translation_to_testable_variables.adaptive_base_grid: 10^(floor(log10(first observed UTC-day price))-2), fixed for the rest of that symbol-day
translation_to_testable_variables.round_levels: integer multiples of 0.5x, 1x or 2x the adaptive base grid
translation_to_testable_variables.acceptance: after a boundary crossing, the last observed confirmation-window trade remains on the destination side by a frozen fraction of the grid, aligned aggressor flow is nonnegative or strongly positive, and destination-side notional dominates
translation_to_testable_variables.rejection: the crossed level was reached, but the last observed confirmation-window trade returns to the origin side by a frozen grid fraction while aggressor flow and traded-notional location point back toward the origin
translation_to_testable_variables.direction: crossing direction for acceptance-continuation; opposite crossing direction for rejection-reversal

data_contract.market: USDT linear perpetual public historical trades
data_contract.fit_role: mechanism and feasibility evidence only; the dimensionless 576-cell rule grid below is already frozen and no runtime threshold is learned from PnL
data_contract.integrity: downloaded gzip bytes, CSV header, row count, nondecreasing timestamps and SHA-256 are recorded

causal_event_contract.boundary_event: a trade price crosses one or more frozen round-grid multiples relative to the immediately preceding trade
causal_event_contract.entry_mark: first observed trade at or after crossing time plus confirmation window plus latency
causal_event_contract.one_global_slot: enforced independently for every candidate and horizon across BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT; the slot remains occupied through the first observed exit trade at or after the horizon
causal_event_contract.same_timestamp_tie_break: entry timestamp, then stable symbol, then deterministic event ID
causal_event_contract.missing_exit: the event is unavailable to that horizon and is never favorably filled

cost_and_execution_screen.funding: not separately modeled over 2-30 minute diagnostic markouts; any survivor must receive exact funding and structural-exit NAV replay
cost_and_execution_screen.qualification: fatal alpha screen only; public trade marks can reject the family but cannot promote it into the cumulative strategy ranking

conditional_next_stage.if_zero_survivors: register reusable negative evidence, keep 2024-2026 sealed and move to a materially different information source or payoff
conditional_next_stage.if_one_or_more_survivors: freeze one survivor without retuning, reconstruct exact Bybit BBO/depth and structural exits on broader pre-2024 data, then decide whether a sequential 2024 opening is warranted

prohibitions: no same-trade, pre-confirmation or pre-latency entry
no use of session profile, liquidation, cross-venue, options, positioning or future acknowledgement state
no cumulative strategy-rank promotion from this sparse screen
